body.name: Tree-diagonal extended formulation
body.construction: \(\mathcal R(P)=\{(q,\{U_h(k)\},\{V_{ha}(k)\}):U_h(-1)=V_{ha}(-1)=0,\ U_h(K-1)=V_{ha}(K-1)=\rho_h,\ \Delta U_h(k)\geq0,\ \Delta V_{ha}(k)\geq0,\ U_h(k)\leq V_{ha}(k),\ \Delta U_h(k)\leq\sum_{a\in\mathcal A(h)}\Delta V_{ha}(k),\ V_{ha}(k)=\sum_{h'\in\operatorname{ch}(h,a)}U_{h'}(k)\text{ on nonterminal branches},\ V_{ha}(k)=b_{ha}(k)\text{ on terminal branches},\ F_q(k)=\sum_{h\in\mathcal H_0}U_h(k)\ \forall h,a,k\}\)
